title: Tamsin and the Veil
author: Tamsin Nystrom
blurb: Edmund Galloway, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
